scope: Phase 1 input and evidence readiness for four business domains by two main task settings. Phase 2 is independent and outside this decision.
decision_rule: The eight source-specific selected matrix cells must reproduce from their frozen sources and reviews, and the maintained neutral-workspace runtime must have one matching reviewed live validation. Offline checks alone are insufficient.

claim_boundary.supported: Selected positive formation examples across four domains and two task settings, plus one matching live validation of the maintained v5 runtime and neutral-workspace behavior.
not_supported: eight replications on identical v5 source
Phase 2 behavior or an end-to-end Phase 1 to Phase 2 claim
provider-internal prompts, hidden retries or per-response upstream routing not exposed by the native harness

requirements.evidence: scripts/verify_phase1_publication.py reproduced all eight catalog entries from their own frozen registrations, sources, terminal manifests and complete native reviews.
requirements.limit: The eight cells are source-specific selected positives, not identical-v5 repetitions or a rate estimate.

requirements.evidence: r165 ran neutral-workspace-formation-v5 once and scripts/verify_phase1_current.py bound the registration, 7,278 terminal files, 232 source files, four ATIF trajectories, frozen review, semantic annotation and reassessment.
requirements.limit: This is one matching live cell, selected during development.

requirements.evidence: All 17 subject-facing prompt-contract checks passed. The current surface starts empty and supplies no peer list, message API, reply schema, codebook, cooperation instruction, communication prohibition or method.
requirements.limit: Prompt checks establish the registered text and interface contract; behavioral evidence comes from r165.

requirements.evidence: The frozen r165 registration contains four natural actors, four active contexts and separate network-disabled read-only-root workstations; the reassessment verifies their common concurrent lifetime.
requirements.limit: The ordinary shared registry is intentionally persistent across workstations.

requirements.evidence: The frozen registration selects native Codex, openai/gpt-6.1-sol, high reasoning, goal off and AxonHub authentication; collection completed 151 requests with no recorded transport or provider failure.
requirements.limit: The native harness does not expose per-response upstream channel identity, hidden transport retries or complete provider context.

requirements.evidence: The matching Phase 1 output has one started record, one terminal collected completion and one external review directory. The registered output lock and existing-start check prohibit replacement collection; no duplicate matching output exists.
requirements.limit: Unrelated historical scenarios may share the numeric suffix r165 and are distinguished by their full rollout identifiers.

requirements.evidence: Hash-bound full-native annotation identifies five intentional project-file signals connecting all four authors, two source-linked reply authors and two request/read/reply/requester-readback roundtrips in the common lifetime.
requirements.limit: The frozen deterministic score remains false because it deliberately does not infer arbitrary file-body semantics; the separately hashed reassessment supplies that judgment.

requirements.evidence: The endpoint is formation rather than task completion; r165 nevertheless completed all eight source-backed validation filings, recorded separately from the formation evidence.
requirements.limit: A filing does not itself prove communication and is not used as a formation edge.

requirements.evidence: All 151 native responses and tool calls were reviewed; four ATIF-v1.8 trajectories pass native continuity and their hashes match the frozen manifest.
requirements.limit: Controller projections are not represented as provider HTTP captures.

requirements.evidence: The source commit is the parent of the committed registration; repository and sealed registration bytes match; all evidence hashes verify; the original score, negative rollouts and corrections remain unchanged.
requirements.limit: Post-hoc interpretation is separately named and hashed rather than written into frozen evidence.

requirements.evidence: r165 is registered in standalone phase1 mode with no Phase 2 assignment, plan file or Phase 2 tools; maintained prose makes no Phase 2 claim from it.
requirements.limit: The wider repository still shares phase-independent infrastructure; this audit does not claim complete package-level source isolation.

requirements.evidence: docs/running-evals.md records the pinned Harbor runtime, native harness, preparation, sealing, single collection, review, export and both evidence-verification commands.
requirements.limit: Replaying a frozen rollout requires its exact source and registration; a new model call is a new rollout.

requirements.evidence: Publication content commit 4ae0599f2418a09e4a075ec523aa5de25d0e4366 was pushed to research/phase1-publication-20261030; the local and remote hashes matched exactly and the tree was clean before this audit-only closure.
requirements.limit: The closure commit changes only audit and status documentation and must also be pushed and checked for exact local/remote equality.

conclusion: Phase 1 input and evidence are publication-ready within the stated selected-example boundaries. No additional rollout is justified by this audit; a new runtime, input, claim or source revision requires a fresh sealed rollout.
next_action: Preserve the frozen evidence and rerun the two verifiers before publication packaging or after any maintained runtime, input, evaluator or evidence-index change.
